column1: Ship Breaking Intelligence — Engine Data Master
Single workbook for all engine input data. Every new data drop updates a sheet here — never re-collate from scratch.
SHEETS IN THIS WORKBOOK
Mandi Master     — daily Alang rates, 11 sources, 576 trading days (Dec 2023 - Jul 2026). COMPLETE.
Summary          — stats + 8ANI benchmark chart, auto-computed from Mandi Master.
QC Log           — every typo/disagreement/inversion caught during parsing, with source.
USD-INR          — DONE (monthly avg, Dec 2023-Jul 2026). Source: exchangerates.org.uk.
Turkey HMS 8020   — daily/weekly Turkey CFR HMS 80:20 futures settle. STILL NEEDED (see open requests).
OPEN DATA REQUESTS (highlighted orange on their sheets)
1. USD-INR: paste the JSON/CSV from this URL (browser or Excel Get-Data-from-Web):
https://api.frankfurter.dev/v1/2023-12-11..2026-07-06?base=USD&symbols=INR
Free, no login. Alternative: RBI reference rate archive (rbi.org.in / fbil.org.in).
2. Turkey HMS 80/20 CFR Turkey futures: needs a Barchart account (free tier = 2 yrs daily,
CSV download). Export Price History for symbol IS7 (continuous) or nearest active contract
and drop the CSV back. Barchart Premier needed for history before ~2 years ago.
HOW TO ADD NEW DATA GOING FORWARD
- New WhatsApp mandi export -> re-run parse_mandi.py -> paste new rows into Mandi Master
(script auto-dedupes/QCs; never overwrite existing rows, only append new dates).
- USD-INR / Turkey HMS: paste new rows at the bottom of their respective sheet, same columns.
- This README + Summary should be updated whenever a new exogenous series is added.
Policy Events    — researched customs/GST/IMO event dates for use as model dummies (see sheet). GMB fee dates still open.
Supply & Substitutes - ship arrivals, Baltic Dry Index, JPC billet/pig iron/sponge iron, Nhava Sheva import parity.
Spot data points via search, refresh periodically (same pattern as BigMint cross-checks).
